name: Central Library & Digital Knowledge Hub
facilities: Quiet Reading Halls with 500+ individual charging pods
Digital Research Lab & IEEE / ACM Journal Terminals
Automated RFID Book Issue & Return Kiosk
Group Discussion Rooms (Bookable via portal)
tip: Ground floor has quiet study cubicles; 2nd floor has high-speed Wi-Fi and discussion rooms.
directionsFromGate: Walk straight 150m past the Flag Plaza, take the right walkway behind Academic Block 1.

name: Central Canteen & Nescafe Food Court
location: Next to Student Activity Center (SAC) & Lawn 2
facilities: Multi-cuisine Food Stalls (Dosa, Thali, Chinese, Rolls, Chaat)
Nescafe Express Bar with iced frappe & grilled sandwiches
Large shaded gazebo seating with music lounge
All UPI & Student RFID Smart Card payments accepted
tip: Peak rush is 12:30 PM - 1:45 PM. The Maggi and cold coffee corner behind SAC is a fresher favorite!
directionsFromGate: From main gate, follow the central boulevard towards the left of the sports grounds.

name: Academic Block 1 & Lecture Theatre Complex
location: Directly opposite Main University Entrance Gate
facilities: Stepped Smart Lecture Theatres with dual interactive screens
Central Computing Center (CCC) with 300 Linux/Win terminals
Faculty Cabins & Teaching Assistant Consultation Desks
Filtered Water Stations and Lift access on all wings
tip: All 1st Year CSE, ECE & Common Theory Lectures happen in LHC-101 and LHC-102.
directionsFromGate: Located immediately inside the Main Entrance Gate, right hand side.

name: Indoor Sports Complex & Athletics Arena
location: East Wing, adjacent to Boys Hostel 3 & 4
facilities: 4 Wooden Badminton Courts & 6 Table Tennis Tables
Olympic Swimming Pool with certified lifeguards
Modern Gym & Strength Training Wing with trainers
Floodlit Basketball, Volleyball & Lawn Tennis courts
tip: Gym registration for freshers is free for the first semester! Bring 2 photos and ID card.
directionsFromGate: Take the east ring road for 300m, located right past the cafeteria lawn.

name: Administration Block (Registrar & Dean Office)
location: Near Main Flag Plaza & Clock Tower
facilities: Student Affairs & Dean Academics Office
Accounts & Scholarship Helpdesk (Counters 1-3)
Bonafide Certificate, Bus Pass & ID Card Dispenser (Counter 4)
Anti-Ragging Squad & Student Welfare Cell
tip: Counter 4 handles ID cards and fee verification. Visit before 1:00 PM to avoid lines.
directionsFromGate: Walk 100m straight from the entrance gate towards the Clock Tower.

name: Campus Health & Wellness Center
location: Behind Health Plaza, near Girls Hostel Complex
facilities: Resident Medical Officers, Nurses & Pharmacist
Free consultations, basic medicines, and first-aid care
Dedicated 24/7 Campus Ambulance Service (Dial 108 / Ext: 2222)
Confidential Student Counseling & Mental Wellbeing Pods
tip: Emergency Doctor Hotline: 0175-2393-021 (Direct speed dial from campus intercom: 2222).
directionsFromGate: Follow the West pathway past the Humanities block towards Girls Hostel Gate.
